channel.title: bytevikas Blog
channel.description: Android engineering articles by Vikas Dhiman: performance, architecture, Jetpack Compose, Kotlin, Media3, and AI-assisted development.

item.title: Android Dev Summit 2026: LeakCanary in the CLI, R8 Analysis, Recomposition Tracing and Lightbuild
item.description: The Dev Summit tools post, performance half: android profiler leakcanary, android analyze and the R8 Configuration Analyzer, Tracing 2.0, recomposition tracing, Crashlytics heap dumps and the experimental Lightbuild YAML build.

item.title: Jetpack XR SDK 1.0.0 Is Stable: ARCore and SceneCore GA, What Moves in 1.1 Alpha
item.description: ARCore and SceneCore hit 1.0.0 stable on Oct 21. XR Compose is still beta02 with a SceneCore leak workaround, and 1.1.0-alpha01 adds SpatialAnnotation, dynamic meshes and simpler glTF animation.

item.title: Android Studio Rabbit 2: Bring Your Own Agent via ACP, Plus AI Change Review
item.description: Rabbit 2 makes Bring Your Own Agent stable: 40+ ACP agents including Claude Agent and Codex, a Skills Manager and a /review walkthrough for agent changes. Setup, what agents can access and the CLI plugins.

item.title: A2UI for Jetpack Compose: Let AI Agents Render Native UI From Your Component Catalog
item.description: AndroidX now ships an official Compose renderer for the A2UI protocol. The agent describes the UI in JSON, your catalog decides what can render. A2uiSurface, custom components, two-way bindings and what changed in alpha02.

item.title: Compose 1.13 Beta: PolygonShape Rewrite, Required Slider onValueChange and a Faster Modifier.border
item.description: Beta01 and beta02 of Compose 1.13 break PolygonShape, Slider, Modifier.blur and MediaQuery posture APIs, require Kotlin 2.2, and ship a new Modifier.border with opt-out flags. What to fix before stable.

item.title: Gemini 4 Argon for Android: Self-Healing Builds, AGSL Shaders and the android-cli-plugin
item.description: Gemini 4 Argon arrives for Android developers through Antigravity, Android Studio Canary and Firebase AI Logic. Self-healing build loops, AGSL shaders in Compose, android-cli-plugin setup, and who actually has access.

item.title: WRITE_CONTACTS Is Going Away: Migrating to Contact Intents and MANAGE_CONTACTS
item.description: Apps targeting the next Android release can no longer write contacts directly. The three standard intents, the Contact Picker and People Directory replace it, and MANAGE_CONTACTS covers the few apps that truly need broad access. Kotlin before/after and a migration checklist.

item.title: Grab Cut ANRs 32% and Startup 35% with R8 Full Mode and Baseline Profiles: The Playbook
item.description: Grab's 10-million-line superapp went from legacy ProGuard config to R8 Full Mode in phases: ~32.5% fewer ANRs, ~30% smaller downloads and ~35% faster cold start. The sequencing, the reflection fixes and the CI guardrails worth copying.

item.title: Compose 1.13.0-alpha01: FlexBox Hits Stable, SelectionState API, and the Next Cycle Begins
item.description: Compose 1.12.0 went stable August 12, and alpha01 of 1.13 dropped the same day. FlexBox graduates from experimental (no more @OptIn), a new SelectionState API gives you programmatic text selection control, and click sounds are now automatic on Android.

item.title: Jetpack Compose 1.12.0 Is Stable — Wide Color Gamut, FlexBox, and the Production Upgrade Guide
item.description: Compose 1.12.0 hit stable August 12 alongside Fragment 1.9.0, Tracing 2.0.0, and Navigation3 1.1.6. What's genuinely new vs RC01 (WCG, variable fonts, Dialog blur), what breaks on upgrade, and the exact migration checklist before you bump the BOM.

item.title: X Rebuilt Its Android App from Scratch in Kotlin + Compose — What a Year of Clean-Slate Engineering Looks Like
item.description: X shipped a fully rebuilt Android app on July 20, 2026 — 100% Kotlin, Jetpack Compose end to end, and Kotlin Multiplatform powering X Chat's E2E encryption across Android, iOS, and Web. Here's what a year-long clean-slate rewrite looks like and what every Android engineer can take from it.

item.title: Benchmark 1.5.0 Beta: UiAutomator 2.4, Safer AOT Defaults, and In-Process Trace Merging
item.description: Seven alphas, one beta, and the Benchmark library has its most consequential upgrade since stable. UiAutomator 2.4 lands in MacrobenchmarkScope, requireAot flips to true by default to stop silent JIT-warm measurements, TraceProcessor moves to benchmark-common, and beta01 lets PerfettoCapture merge Tracing 2.0 in-process events into one Perfetto file.

item.title: Fragment 1.9.0-rc01: fragment-ktx Merged, Compose maxLifecycle, and the Maintenance Mode Reality Check
item.description: Fragment 1.9.0 is at RC01. Three practical changes: fragment-ktx is absorbed into the main artifact (Jake Wharton contribution), AndroidFragment gets a maxLifecycle param to fix lifecycle leaks in Compose pagers, and Fragment officially enters maintenance mode. Here's what each means and what to do about it.

item.title: Media3 1.11.0 Stable: OggMuxer, Chapter Metadata, and the Production Upgrade Checklist
item.description: Media3 1.11.0 graduated to stable on August 5. Beyond what alpha01 and beta01 shipped, stable adds OggMuxer and WavMuxer for audio output, MP4 chapter extraction, enablePerStreamMediaProgression() for startup latency, HLS Content Steering, and five API removals to fix before you upgrade.

item.title: Android Skills: Why Google Built an AI Knowledge Layer Designed to Disappear
item.description: Google's official Android Skills are built for deprecation by design — every skill should eventually make itself obsolete as models improve. The philosophy, the evaluation framework (think integration tests for AI knowledge), when skills actually add value, and why only ~20 official ones exist.

item.title: Compose 1.12 RC01: Sound Effects, Passkey Semantics, and the APIs Before Stable
item.description: RC01 shipped July 29 — stable is weeks away. Beyond the visual APIs covered in beta, 1.12 adds SoundEffectOnInteraction for accessibility-aware click sounds, credentialRequest Semantics for passkey-ready Compose login forms, a breaking TextObfuscationMode rename in BasicSecureTextField, and InterceptPlatformTextInput promoted to stable.

item.title: Compose's New Adaptive Layout APIs: FlexBox, Grid, and mediaQuery() Explained
item.description: Three new experimental layout primitives bring CSS-inspired adaptive layouts to Jetpack Compose: FlexBox for flowing content sections, a structural Grid for 2D panels without lazy loading, and mediaQuery() for branching on device posture, pointer precision, and viewing distance — not just window width.

item.title: Jetpack Navigation 2.10 Beta: KMP on 9 Platforms, Richer Predictive Back, and the Maintenance Mode Signal
item.description: Navigation 2.10.0-beta01 ships multiplatform support for Desktop, macOS, iOS, WASM, tvOS, and watchOS; NavBackStackEntryInfo for custom predictive back animations; NavUri replacing android.net.Uri; and a deep link security fix. Plus the honest maintenance mode reality check and a decision tree for Navigation 2.x vs Navigation3.

item.title: ML Kit GenAI Gets @Generable Structured Output and Gemini Nano Speech Recognition
item.description: Google's 'Build intelligent Android apps' series introduced @Generable annotations for type-safe structured output via KSP, and a new genai-speech-recognition 1.0.0-alpha1 library. Here's the integration guide: setup, data class annotations, streaming transcription, and how to go from 13-second receipts parsing to under 2 seconds.

item.title: Play Age Signals API Goes Global: Build Age-Appropriate Android Experiences Without Custom Age Gates
item.description: Google's Play Age Signals API expands to Australia and Canada in mid-August, then globally by year-end. Integration guide with AgeSignalsManager, the four default age tiers, testing with FakeAgeSignalsManager, and the strict policy restrictions that govern what you can actually do with the data.

item.title: Android 17's Security Hardening: The Behavior Changes That Will Break Your Production App
item.description: Seven security and privacy behavior changes in Android 17 that aren't in the other posts: ACCESS_LOCAL_NETWORK permission for LAN access, banned static-final reflection, enforced ECH and Certificate Transparency, stricter native DCL, Contacts Provider 2 PII removal, and more.

item.title: Compose Material3 1.5.0-alpha25: The Expressive API Cleans House
item.description: Alpha25 lands six API renames and two deprecations as M3 Expressive hardens toward stable — trailingIcon becomes trailingContent, TonalToggleButton becomes FilledTonalToggleButton, SplitButtonLayout is deprecated, and ComponentOverride is removed entirely. Plus alpha24's new material3-ripple artifact for inset focus rings.

item.title: Navigation3 1.2.0-alpha07: BackStackMatcher Solves the Deep Link Back-Stack Problem
item.description: Alpha07 adds BackStackMatcher — a declarative way to build a synthetic back stack when handling deep links — plus DeepLinkSerializer for complex argument types, five targeted bug fixes, and Navigation3 1.1.5 stable on the same day.

item.title: 5 Years of Jetpack Compose: Views Enter Maintenance Mode, and What That Actually Means for Your App
item.description: Google officially moved the Views toolkit to maintenance mode — bug fixes only, no new features. 68% of the top 1,000 Play apps already use Compose. Here's what the announcement means for teams still on View-based UI and how to think about the migration now.

item.title: R8 Makes Kotlin Coroutines 2x Faster in AGP 9.2 — and You Don't Change a Single Line
item.description: AGP 9.2.0 ships an R8 optimization that rewrites AtomicReferenceFieldUpdater into direct Unsafe calls, cutting coroutine overhead by half and improving Compose's Modifier.clickable by 2x — automatically. Here's the three-step mechanism and what it means for your benchmarks.

item.title: Galaxy Unpacked 2026: What the New Foldable and Wearable Lineup Means for Android Developers
item.description: Samsung unveiled a new lineup of foldable and wearable devices at Galaxy Unpacked London. The Android team responded the next day with a clear message: your adaptive layout strategy needs to level up. Here's the developer picture — Window 1.6.0 engagement APIs, NavigableListDetailPaneScaffold, and the Android 17 hard deadline.

item.title: Kotlin 2.4.20 Beta2: Sealed Classes Map to Swift Enums, Incremental klib Ships by Default
item.description: Kotlin 2.4.20-Beta2 lands sealed class Swift export for exhaustive enum switching in KMP, incremental klib compilation on by default for faster Kotlin/Native debug builds, four new stdlib collection functions, and an experimental compiler native image.

item.title: Nearby Connections API Is Losing Auto-Radio Management: What Changes and How to Adapt Now
item.description: Google is removing the Nearby Connections API's silent ability to enable Wi-Fi and Bluetooth on your app's behalf. Late 2026 enforcement, all three strategies affected. Here's the pre-flight check pattern and how to audit your connection flows before the deadline.

item.title: Navigation3 1.2.0: Deep Links and Result Passing Fill the Two Biggest Gaps from Stable
item.description: Navigation3 1.2.0-alpha05/06 adds UriDeepLinkMatcher for URI-to-NavKey resolution and ResultEventBus for typed result passing between destinations — the two features that 1.1.4 stable shipped without. Full API surface with real code.

item.title: Google Play Catalog Access Is Live: What Third-Party App Stores Mean for Android Developers
item.description: As of July 22, your Play Store app listing is available to rival US stores by default. Downloads still flow through Play, billing is unchanged, but you now have a decision to make in Play Console. Here's the opt-in/out trade-off, the Epic settlement context, and what actually changes in your app (spoiler: nothing in the APK).
